scope: Experimental FP32 eight-token GDN prefill blocks on genuine Qwen3.8-27B MTP, not a WebGPU or 16K comparison.
interpretation: All 256 generated tokens and every speculative statistic matched across the full control/candidate samples. Warm median TTFT regressed 18.430490 -> 23.961014 seconds; aggregate decode was 7.090545 -> 6.898272 tokens/s. Fixed order, overlapping raw TTFT samples, and unmonitored system paging preclude assigning all of that difference to the kernel. These results do not establish an end-to-end gain or qualify default enablement. The scheduler-256 pilots use only 32 output tokens and one measured sample: their 18.467038 -> 17.581614 second TTFT is diagnostic, not final speed evidence.

isolated_prototype.scope: Fused FP32 chunk8 with direct decay products; no end-to-end claim

isolated_prototype_caveat: Isolated eight-token-block timings do not include ORT, GenAI, whole-model weight GEMMs, cache writebacks, or the whole MTP loop.

validation.notice_packaging: Full MIT notice verified in actual wheel and sdist; Metal source verified in sdist.

recovered_failures: An initial test invocation skipped because ONNXRUNTIME_MLX_EP_LIB was missing; it was not counted as validation.
The initial active run passed six capacity-zero cases and failed twelve capture variants at Metal compilation due to capture-offset/matrix variable shadowing. Renaming capsule_base fixed all cases.
